summary: Phase 1 customer flow tested end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed (auth, JWT 401 guards, OTP mock, catalog seed counts 5/3/4/15, cart math with 5% tax + ₹25 conditional delivery, checkout COD + online (paid), notifications + unread count, no _id leakage). Frontend: Splash → login (logo + Email/Password tab) → demo customer login → home (banners + categories + nearby stores + trending) → add-to-cart bounces badge (3) → categories tab with products grid → product detail (Wireless Headphones) with Add to Cart → cart screen with qty +/- and bill (subtotal/delivery FREE>₹199/tax 5%/total) → proceed-to-checkout → address form save → COD place order → /orders/{id} detail with 4-stage tracker (Order Placed → Accepted → Out for Delivery → Delivered) → notifications screen → profile → logout returns to login. All testIDs present and functional. No red screen errors, no broken images. Razorpay & OTP are documented mocks (acceptable for Phase 1).

issues: Right-side product grid is partially clipped horizontally on 390px viewport — the right column 'Add' button is half-cut. Consider reducing card width or using flex layout so two columns fit within available width.
Product name truncates awkwardly ('Fresh To...', 'Brown ...') — increase numberOfLines to 2 or widen card.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props deprecated by React Native Web — replace with boxShadow. Console warning fires repeatedly. Reference: any component using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius.
props.pointerEvents is deprecated; use style.pointerEvents instead. Console warning. Likely from Animated.View or overlay components.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Migrate React Native shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence RN-Web warnings.
(Optional/cosmetic) Move pointerEvents from prop to style on Animated.View / overlays.
(UI polish) Fix categories screen right-column clipping on 390px width and increase product-name numberOfLines to 2.
(Noisy log, non-blocking) Backend startup shows passlib/bcrypt '__about__' AttributeError warning — bcrypt 4.x changed module structure; pin bcrypt<4 or upgrade passlib. Auth still works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 647-line file holding models, routes, helpers, and seed data; consider splitting into routers/, models/, seed/ for maintainability before Phase 2 (vendor/delivery/admin) adds more endpoints.
JWT_SECRET has a hardcoded fallback string. For production builds the env var must be required (drop the fallback).
Seed runs at every startup and re-checks counts/emails — idempotent and fine, but consider gating with an env flag for prod.
seed_data_creation: Test addresses prefixed with 'TEST_' are created and deleted within the same test. One real address + order were created via the UI run under the demo customer account (KMT260615A266) — not cleaned up since it represents a normal customer order; safe to ignore or delete via DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 customer flow is green. Demo customer (customer@kmtbazaar.com / Customer@123) has at least one historical order in DB from this run. For re-test, hit DELETE /api/cart/clear before adding items. All testIDs are kebab-case: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, add-to-cart-{productId}, cart-badge, proceed-to-checkout, addr-name/phone/line1/city/state/pincode, save-address, add-address-btn, payment-cod, payment-online, place-order-btn, logout-button. Bottom tabs do NOT have testIDs on the tab triggers themselves — navigate via expo-router URLs (/home, /categories, /cart, /profile). Phase 2 should test vendor/delivery/admin dashboards (currently placeholders at /role/[role]).
rca_of_issue: No bugs requiring RCA. All listed action items are cosmetic warnings or refactor suggestions.
